phrase: an Ayurvedic Hair and Skin Care Brand
verdict: Yes. Avimee Herbal from Surat pitched ayurvedic hair and skin products on Shark Tank India Season 2, but didn't get a deal. Herbal hair oils and skincare sell well with good marketing.
angle: Herbal hair oils and skincare are among India's biggest personal-care categories. Before-and-after results and creator marketing drive sales. AYUSH licensing is required.
